feedback: This geometry's symmetric 5-sensor array and moderate sensor size should provide good line detection and steering precision, as hypothesized. If the next race shows frequent line loss events or high rms_error, consider increasing sensor size to 0.016 m to improve coverage and reduce noise sensitivity. If steering oscillation or control effort is high, try reducing kp or kd gains or slightly increasing wheel track to improve stability. If progress is low or the robot stalls, consider increasing base_speed or reducing mass to improve acceleration. These suggestions are based on prior experience where larger sensors reduced line loss and wider wheel tracks improved stability.
